sections.content: Loops repeat code. A for loop runs a fixed number of times — perfect when you know how many iterations you need.
The classic pattern counts from a start to an end value. Many languages also let you loop directly over list items, which is often cleaner.
Key points: watch off-by-one errors (does the end value count?), loop variables are scoped to the loop in modern languages.
